summary.en: How a situation is interpreted shapes feeling and action; interpretations and expectations can be noticed and tested.
summary.ru: То, как истолкована ситуация, влияет на чувства и действия; толкования и ожидания можно заметить и проверить.

mentalModel.summary: Thoughts, feelings and actions influence each other; small tests of an expectation can change it.
assumptions: behaviour can be tried in small steps
mentalModel.unitOfAnalysis: a situation and what went through the mind just before
mentalModel.howChangeHappens: By noticing and testing interpretations and trying small different actions.
mentalModel.languageGuidance: Offer questions, not corrections; never call a thought irrational or distorted.

do: ask what went through the mind
offer the thought record as an option
dont: argue the person out of a view

exploratoryQuestions: Which interpretations and expectations shaped the reaction and the action?

toolkit.name: Thought record
toolkit.description: Write the situation, the thought, the feeling, the action and an alternative.
cautions: Store the person's own entries only

representations.description: Five columns, in the person's words.

suggestionRequires: the person asked for a way to look at a recurring reaction

citations.ref: doi:10.1007/s10608-012-9476-1 (Hofmann et al. 2012, review of meta-analyses)
citations.note: Clinical efficacy literature not reviewed in this workflow

evidence.notes: OHC use is non-clinical self-reflection; no efficacy claim is made.

ip.itemsLicence: store the person's own entries, not published worksheet text
